Уже хохлы на своих площадях на западной Украине начали выпускать свой аналог американского гусеничного бронетранспортера М-113. А что же мы, ведь ВПК работает? Мы перевооружаем армию на пистолет Лебедева, модернизируем сложный ЗРПК «Панцирь», выдаем самые высокотехнологичные в мире системы ПВО, выпускаем «умные» ракеты с малыми турбированными двигателями, «Филины», «Молнии» и т.д. Все стараются. Но такое впечатление, что именно бронетехники это не касается. Ни одного нового образца, подходящего под идущий конфликт! Не говоря уже про большие колёсные бронетранспортёры, про которые все говорят: «Армии нужен тяжёлый, большой БТР с комфортным расположением десанта внутри под броней, с большим аппарельным люком, позволяющим десант, эвакуацию, раненого затянуть». Но ничего не происходит. Это нормально? Клепаем и клепаем технику прошлого века устаревших войн и конфликтов. Пора прийти в себя. Это вопрос, в первую очередь, к конструкторам и производителям, которые, являясь монополистом в своём секторе, ничего не меняют. Почему старается тот же «Калашников»? Потому что не монополист. Расслабляться нельзя — в любой момент могут «подъесть» Ковровский завод, Тульские мастерские, тот же Лобаев, ОРСИС и т.д. Но с новыми БТР, БМП и танками как отрезало. ✉️ On November 26, Russia's President Vladimir Putin sent his greetings to the participants, organisers and guests of the International Open Forum Zhukov. Legacy . ✍️ The message reads, in part: In 2026, we celebrate a landmark event: the 130th birth anniversary of Georgy Zhukov , a renowned military leader, an outstanding statesman and a worthy son of the Fatherland. Georgy Zhukov devoted his life to serving the nation, and had a heroic military career – from a private in the First World War to a Marshal of the Soviet Union. His military talent, personal bravery, and the ability to make astute and strategically balanced decisions in the most challenging situations earned him truly nationwide acclaim and largely predetermined the outcome of the final, epoch-making battles of the Great Patriotic War. I am confident that projects such as your large-scale Forum and the science outreach day organised in his home region – the town of Zhukov and the village of Strelkovka, Kaluga Region – will greatly contribute to preserving the memory of our national heroes , including Marshal of Victory Georgy Zhukov, and to the education of our young people, reinforcing the traditions of patriotism and personal responsibility for the future of our Motherland.

🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 26 November 2026 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. ↗️ The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. In Kharkov region, strikes have been delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one national guard brigade close to Sosnovka, Velikiy Burluk, Kolodeznoye, and Pitomnik. 💥 In Sumy region, formations of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one territorial defence brigade have been hit close to Obody, Vakalovshchina, Zhovtnevoye, and Novopetrovka. ▪️ The enemy lost up to 155 troops, six motor vehicles, three electronic warfare stations, and one electronic reconnaissance station. 📍 The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade near Osadkovka, Vasilevka, Maliyevka (Kharkov region) and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 220 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 15 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun. 📍 The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. Formations of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, and one mountain assault brigade of the AFU have been hit near Cherevkovka, Vysokoivanovka, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, and Belenkoye (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 175 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 11 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station. ↗️ The Tsentr Group's units continued to carry out active offensive operations. Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades near Kalinino, Kuritsyno, Krinitsy, Novopavlovka, and Zavido-Kudashevo (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 340 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, seven armoured fighting vehicles, six motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station. 📍 The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence. They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one air assault brigade, one assault brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Veseloye, Novotroitskoye, Novoivanovka, Novorozovka (Zaporozhye region) and Gavrilovka (Dnepropetrovsk region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 200 troops and eight motor vehicles. ↗️ The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line. The Group's units inflicted fire damage on formations of one mechanised brigade of the AFU near Kamyshevakha (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ Up to 20 troops and 16 motor vehicles of the AFU have been neutralised. ✈️ Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have hit power infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU, production workshops and storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles and ground robotic systems, temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed groups and foreign mercenaries in 146 areas. ▫️ Air defence systems shot down four U.S.-made JDAM aerial bombs, two Neptune long-range guided missiles, and 872 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles. 📊 In total, since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost: ▫️ 674 aircraft, ▫️ 284 helicopters, ▫️ 298,885 unmanned aerial vehicles, ▫️ 672 anti-aircraft missile systems, ▫️ 31,782 tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles, ▫️ 1,797 MLRS combat vehicles, ▫️ 36,989 field artillery guns and mortars, ▫️ 78,075 special military vehicles. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
